chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah; and he explained them in...

For al-Ẓuhr, twenty-one takbirs; and in al-ʿAṣr, twenty-one takbirs; and in al-Maghrib, sixteen takbirs; and in al-ʿIshāʾ al-Ākhirah, twenty-one takbirs; and in al-Fajr, eleven; and five takbirs in the qunut in five prayers.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةً: a single utterance of "Allāhu Akbar" within the prayer

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited in each of the five daily prayers and in the qunut?
ai.summary: This report lists the number of takbirs associated with each of the five daily prayers and mentions takbirs in the qunut. It pertains to the ritual form of salat and serves as a jurisprudential report about devotional practice.
